name: Harmonica call and response
desc: Blues harp in Eb (vcsl harmonica): blues-scale licks — root, flat third, fourth, flat five, fifth, flat seven — phrased as two-bar calls with two bars of silence for the response, heavy vibrato, 12/8 triplet feel. Little Walter after midnight; peak answers its own calls an octave up.

code.full: note("<[eb4 ~ gb4 ab4 ~ a4 bb4 ~ ~ gb4 eb4 ~] [~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~] [bb4 ~ ab4 gb4 ~ eb4 gb4 ~ ~ eb4 ~ ~] [~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("harmonica_vib").clip(1.2).shape(.35).lpf(3400).gain(${gain}).room(.32).every(8, x=>x.rev()).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: note("<[eb4 ~ gb4 ab4 ~ a4 bb4 ~ db5 bb4 gb4 eb4] [eb5 ~ ~ gb5 ~ ~ eb5 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~] [bb4 ~ ab4 gb4 ~ eb4 gb4 ab4 a4 bb4 ~ ~] [eb5 db5 bb4 ab4 gb4 eb4 ~ ~ eb4 ~ ~ ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("harmonica_vib").clip(1).shape(.4).lpf(3800).gain(${gain}).room(.3).lastOf(8, x=>x.rev()).orbit(5).play()
